title: Double prediction graph
symptom: Running latest nightly, the user gets two prediction graphs and doesn't know which one is right. The prediction line shows a jump or break, and sometimes the two lines overlap in time. The behavior appears randomly after entering carbs and bolus insulin at the same time.
evidence_quote: Most often, after adding carbs and bolus insulin at the same time, the double graph appears. It is not a simple skip. The graph in total becomes quite irrational.
